title: Sirt1 sustains Sonic hedgehog signaling to promote medulloblastoma progression through regulating Gli3 processing
task: Identify Sirt1's role in sustaining SHH signaling in medulloblastoma through Gli3 processing regulation
key_results: Sirt1 is highly expressed in SHH-type MB; Sirt1 knockdown suppresses SHH signaling and MB proliferation; Sirt1 deacetylates Gli3FL to inhibit its processing into repressor form Gli3R; Sirt1 inhibition extends survival in orthotopic MB models
comments: Well-characterized mechanistic link between histone deacetylation and pathway signal propagation, with promising preclinical therapeutic validation, though translation to clinical efficacy remains pending.

model_io.model: Genetically engineered mouse SHH-type medulloblastoma
Primary and xenograft MB cell culture
Orthotopic transplantation MB model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sirt1 activity sustains SHH signaling by preventing Gli3 processing into repressor form
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Sirt1 deacetylates Gli3FL and inhibits its conversion to Gli3R

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sirt1 inhibition impairs MB progression and extends survival
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in both subcutaneous and primary transplantation models

title: Developmental system drift in dorsoventral patterning is linked to transitions to autonomous development in Annelida
task: Clarify BMP pathway's ancestral role in dorsoventral patterning across Annelida and link developmental system drift to reproductive mode transitions
key_results: BMP is ancestrally downstream of ERK1/2 in annelids; species with unequal spiral cleavage show loss of this hierarchy and divergent use of Activin/Nodal or BMP for head patterning only
comments: Elegant integration of comparative developmental biology revealing how reproductive strategy shifts couple to extensive signaling rewiring, though mechanistic details of downstream target divergence remain to be elucidated.

model_io.model: Comparative annelid embryogenesis

hypotheses.hypothesis: BMP functions ancestrally downstream of ERK1/2 in dorsoventral patterning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in ancestral annelid species; hierarchy lost in unequal cleavage lineages

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transition to autonomous development causes signaling system rewiring
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; parallel shifts to unequal spiral cleavage correlate with divergent BMP/Activin roles

title: Small-molecule FTO inhibitor MO-I-500 protects C8-B4 microglial cells from erastin-induced ferroptosis
task: Determine role of FTO-mediated m6A demethylation in ferroptosis regulation
key_results: FTO inhibition with MO-I-500 significantly decreased erastin-induced ferroptosis, ROS production, and lipid accumulation in C8-B4 microglial cells
comments: Establishes epitranscriptomic control of ferroptosis via FTO, though the specific m6A target transcripts mediating protection remain unidentified.

model_io.model: C8-B4 microglial cell ferroptosis assay

hypotheses.hypothesis: FTO inhibition protects cells from ferroptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MO-I-500 treatment attenuates erastin-induced ferroptotic markers

title: m6A demethylase FTO promotes the progression of abdominal aortic aneurysm through PDK4-mediated apoptosis
task: Elucidate FTO's role in regulating VSMC apoptosis in abdominal aortic aneurysm via m6A-mediated PDK4 degradation
key_results: FTO is elevated in AAA models; FTO silencing reduces AngII-induced VSMC apoptosis via YTHDF2-dependent PDK4 mRNA degradation; PDK4 overexpression rescues apoptosis inhibition
comments: Sophisticated m6A regulatory mechanism linking epitranscriptomics to metabolic and mitochondrial dysfunction, though in vivo therapeutic validation in AAA models is limited.

model_io.model: m6A-mediated mRNA regulation in VSMCs
Integrated RNA-seq and MeRIP-seq analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: FTO regulates VSMC apoptosis through m6A demethylation of PDK4
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FTO mediates m6A demethylation in PDK4 3'UTR and promotes YTHDF2-dependent degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: PDK4 is required for apoptosis suppression when FTO is inhibited
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PDK4 overexpression reverses apoptosis-inhibitory effects of FTO silencing

title: Systematic identification of rare disease patients in electronic health records enables evaluation of clinical outcomes
task: Systematic identification of rare disease patients in EHRs and evaluation of COVID-19 outcomes
key_results: Semi-automated workflow mapped 12,003 GARD IDs to 12,081 SNOMED-CT and 357 ICD-10 codes; identified 316,836 (6.55%) COVID-19 patients with preexisting RD; rare cardiac diseases showed OR=4.07 and otorhinolaryngologic diseases OR=4.00 for mortality
comments: Large-scale EHR study with strong clinical relevance, though the workflow's 88.4% precision on manually curated subset suggests potential false positives in the larger N3C cohort.

model_io.model: Semi-automated RD mapping workflow + logistic regression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Preexisting rare diseases are significantly associated with increased severe COVID-19 outcomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; most RD classes showed significantly elevated odds of hospitalization and mortality

title: Privacy-preserving federated learning with optimized ensemble weighting and knowledge distillation for COVID-19 detection from non-IID medical imaging data
task: Privacy-preserving federated learning for COVID-19 detection from non-IID medical imaging with differential privacy
key_results: IKDEFL achieved 82.79% accuracy and 82.78% F1-score on non-IID data; Tree Adaptive DP reached 76.62% accuracy under strict privacy (ε=3.90, δ=10⁻³), closely matching non-private performance
comments: Practical federated framework addressing real privacy constraints, though evaluation on single disease (COVID-19) limits broader applicability claim.

model_io.model: IKDEFL: Independent Knowledge Distillation + Federated Learning + Differential Privacy (Fixed Gaussian, Gaussian Adaptive, Tree Adaptive)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive DP mechanisms achieve better privacy-utility trade-off than fixed DP in federated healthcare models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Tree Adaptive DP provided superior balance with minimal accuracy loss under strict privacy constraints

title: Phytochemical characterization and antidiabetic potential of Carum carvi L. seeds from Beni Mellal-Khenifra: in vitro, in vivo, in silico and ADME investigations
task: Phytochemical characterization and antidiabetic evaluation of Carum carvi seeds with ADME and molecular docking
key_results: Extract contains 0.27±0.08 mg QE/mg DM flavonoids and 0.57±0.07 mg GAE/mg DM polyphenols; α-amylase IC50=0.139±0.023 mg/mL; α-glucosidase IC50=56.66±1.247 µg/mL; catechin showed best docking (−7.9 kcal/mol for α-amylase, −6.9 kcal/mol for α-glucosidase)
comments: Comprehensive traditional medicine validation study with good experimental design, though animal studies are limited to normal mice and lack diabetic disease models.

model_io.model: Phytochemical analysis + enzyme inhibition assays + in vivo mouse models + molecular docking + ADME prediction
inputs: Carum carvi L. seed aqueous extract

hypotheses.hypothesis: Carum carvi aqueous extract exerts antihyperglycemic effects via α-amylase and α-glucosidase inhibition with good safety margin
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; extract showed significant enzyme inhibition and postprandial hyperglycemia reduction without hypoglycemic effects or toxicity

title: Safe-by-redesign guidance for toxic industrial chemicals using explainable artificial intelligence: Introducing the DETOX-QSAR model
task: Toxicity prediction and computational redesign of toxic industrial chemicals for safe-by-design guidance
key_results: DETOX-QSAR consensus model identified nX and minwHBa as key toxicity descriptors; Arsine successfully modified to eliminate inhalation toxicity via SHAP-guided descriptor optimization; all candidate compounds comply with Lipinski's criteria
comments: Innovative XAI application for green chemistry, though in silico toxicity redesign has not been experimentally validated on the recommended compounds.

model_io.model: DETOX-QSAR: consensus ensemble (SVM, RF, XGBoost, CatBoost) + SHAP + MCDM + molecular docking

hypotheses.hypothesis: Machine learning consensus model with explainable AI can identify and redesign toxic chemicals to eliminate hazards
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Arsine descriptors were successfully modified to eliminate predicted toxicity while maintaining drug-like properties

title: Uncertainty-Aware adaptive neuro-fuzzy transformer framework for robust multi-center lung disease classification
task: Multi-center lung disease classification from chest radiographs with uncertainty estimation and domain generalization
key_results: Cross-dataset accuracy drop reduced by 3.8%, minority-class recall improved by 9.6%, calibration error (ECE) reduced by 41% versus CNN-fuzzy baselines
comments: The adaptive neuro-fuzzy approach is novel, but the evaluation focuses on three radiograph datasets and would benefit from testing on additional imaging modalities.

model_io.model: UANFT: Swin Transformer backbone + Bayesian uncertainty + adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference + correlation alignment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint learning of features, uncertainty, and fuzzy parameters improves cross-dataset robustness and calibration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with significant ECE reduction and reduced accuracy drop across datasets

title: AttnEffNet-B4: an attention-augmented EfficientNet-B4 framework with fourier transformation for robust multi-disease diagnosis
task: Multi-disease diagnosis from diverse medical imaging modalities using attention-augmented deep learning
key_results: AttnEffNet-B4 achieved 97.69% training accuracy and 94.47% testing accuracy across multiple diseases; outperformed EfficientNetB0, VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50, and InceptionV3 baselines
comments: High performance on multiple imaging modalities is impressive, but generalization to real-world clinical deployment remains unclear without external validation cohorts.

model_io.model: AttnEffNet-B4: EfficientNet-B4 + attention mechanism + Fourier transformation + transfer learning

hypotheses.hypothesis: Attention-augmented architecture with Fourier transformation improves multi-disease classification accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieved 94.47% test accuracy exceeding baseline CNN models

title: Predictive models for the occurrence and lymph node metastasis of papillary thyroid carcinoma with regional risk heterogeneity
task: Transcriptomics-based prediction of papillary thyroid carcinoma occurrence and lymph node metastasis with regional heterogeneity
key_results: DNN diagnostic model AUC=0.987, accuracy=0.945; metastasis model AUC=0.998, accuracy=0.987; identified SYT1, REN, CNTN5, ADAM12 as PTC diagnostic markers and COL9A1, CYP4F3, GAD1 for metastasis; regional differences in PTC risk factors but common metastasis pathways
comments: Robust retrospective study with good model performance and SHAP/KAN interpretability, but lacks prospective validation and the online tool explicitly disclaims clinical use.

model_io.model: Deep Neural Networks (DNN) + SHAP + Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN)
inputs: GEO transcriptomics (419 samples: 158 normal, 203 PTC, 58 metastatic)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transcriptomic signatures enable accurate PTC diagnosis and metastasis prediction with interpretable critical gene markers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DNN models achieved >0.98 AUC with identified biomarkers showing mechanistic relevance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Risk factors for PTC occurrence show regional heterogeneity while metastasis drivers exhibit geographic consistency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stratification analysis revealed regional differences in occurrence but commonalities in metastasis pathways

title: AI Augmented Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy for Rapid Intraoperative Diagnosis of Brain Tumors
task: Intraoperative brain tumor diagnosis via confocal laser endomicroscopy with AI augmentation
key_results: CLE diagnostic accuracy 0.94 vs frozen section 0.92 (P=0.14); CLE turnaround 5m56s vs FS 20m (P<0.001); AI Swin Transformer model achieved 0.94 accuracy for tumor detection and 0.88 for biopsy subtype
comments: Compelling prospective multicenter trial with practical speed advantage, though AI model requires integration validation before clinical deployment.

model_io.model: Swin Transformer-based AI diagnostic model

hypotheses.hypothesis: CLE with AI augmentation provides non-inferior diagnostic accuracy to frozen section with significantly faster turnaround
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; comparable accuracy (0.94 vs 0.92) with 3.4-fold faster median turnaround

title: Data-driven mouse motor thalamus model reveals topography and spatial weight scaling govern spindle dynamics
task: Data-driven reconstruction of mouse motor thalamus circuit linking anatomy to spindle dynamics
key_results: 3D anatomical scaffold model reproduces physiological spindle oscillations at realistic frequencies with propagation velocities matching experimental observations; ablation studies confirm topography and distance-dependent synaptic weights are necessary for proper dynamics
comments: The reusable pipeline is valuable, but validation across additional brain regions beyond motor thalamus would strengthen claims of generalizability.

model_io.model: 3D geometrically constrained virtual circuit with network simulations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topography and distance-dependent synaptic weights are necessary for physiological spindle dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via systematic ablation studies

title: Multimodal artificial intelligence and online learning in youth mental health: a scoping review
task: Scoping review of multimodal AI and online learning applications in youth mental health diagnosis and monitoring
key_results: Limited research integrating multimodal AI and online learning for youth mental health; online learning studies show enhanced model performance and adaptability; most studies use single data modality with offline training
comments: Timely review identifying critical methodological gaps, though absence of systematic quality assessment and heterogeneous study designs limit quantitative synthesis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Online learning approaches enhance AI model performance and real-world adaptability for youth mental health applications
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; studies incorporating online learning demonstrated improved performance and adaptability versus static offline models

title: Tapered feedline based quad-port dual-band MIMO antenna at 24/38 GHz for next generation communication systems
task: Quad-port MIMO antenna design for millimeter-wave dual-band operation
key_results: Dual-band operation at 24/38 GHz with 7×24×0.25 mm³ footprint; inter-element isolation >21 dB; gains >5.68 dBi; ECC <0.018; data rate 120 Mbps over 120 m distance
comments: Compact design with excellent isolation and diversity metrics; mechanical flexibility testing adds value for wearable applications.

model_io.model: Quad-port MIMO antenna with modified T-shaped ground plane slots

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modified ground plane T-shaped slots achieve dual-band resonance with high inter-element isolation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; isolation >21 dB at both 24 and 38 GHz bands

title: Bandgap characteristics and optimization of two-dimensional phononic metamaterials with functionally graded rings
task: Bandgap optimization in 2D phononic metamaterials with functionally graded rings
key_results: FGR thickness and power-law exponent strongly modulate bandgap width and center frequency; maximum bandgap width achieved at specific thickness; NSGA-II optimization yielded Pareto front showing nonlinear trade-offs
comments: Multi-objective optimization approach is comprehensive; nonlinear regulatory effects of power-law exponent are important for practical metamaterial design.

model_io.model: Plane wave expansion method (PWEM) with genetic algorithm optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Power-law exponent variations produce nonlinear effects on bandgap width and center frequency with favorable competitive trade-off
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; NSGA-II identified Pareto front showing bandgap width and center frequency competitive relationship

title: Dynamic response of tri-layered functionally graded-viscoelastic-piezomagnetic cylindrical tunnel excited by circumferential shear horizontal waves
task: Circumferential wave propagation in tri-layered functionally graded-viscoelastic-piezomagnetic cylinders
key_results: Phase velocity and stress distribution strongly influenced by gradation parameters, layer radii, and imperfection factors; detailed stress profiles reveal material damping and interface condition interactions
comments: Novel focus on stress distribution alongside phase velocity analysis; comprehensive treatment of interface imperfections is valuable for composite design but computational intensity not discussed.

model_io.model: Analytical dispersion relation for tri-layered cylindrical structure with SH waves

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interface imperfections and material gradation significantly alter stress landscape and wave dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stress profiles show strong dependence on gradation, damping, and imperfection factors

title: Scalable multi-objective genetic algorithm for quantum circuit optimization
task: Scalable quantum circuit optimization for NISQ devices
key_results: Reduced computational complexity from O(2^2n) to O(2^2k); achieved 10× speedup at 14 qubits; fidelity >0.80 for 32-qubit circuits; up to 45% circuit depth reduction
comments: Block-based and sliding-window decomposition strategies address critical scalability bottleneck; trade-off between fidelity and circuit size is well-managed for practical NISQ applications.

model_io.model: NSGA-II multi-objective genetic algorithm with graph partitioning and sliding-window decomposition

hypotheses.hypothesis: Block-based evaluation and sliding-window decomposition reduce full-unitary evaluation complexity without sacrificing fidelity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; complexity reduction enables optimization beyond 20 qubits with high fidelity (>0.80 at 32 qubits)

title: First-principle study of electronic, optical and transport properties for A₂CdB₄ (A = Sc, Y; B = S, Se) spinel chalcogenides under strain condition
task: Strain-tuned electronic, optical, and thermoelectric properties of spinel chalcogenides
key_results: Direct bandgaps strongly strain-dependent (±8%); ZT reaches 0.78–0.79 at 800 K under +8% tensile strain; electrical conductivity enhanced by tensile strain; thermal conductivity reduced by phonon scattering
comments: Strain engineering effectively tunes bandgap and thermoelectric performance; ZT values are modest but promising for device optimization.

model_io.model: First-principles FP-LAPW + lo calculations with GGA and TB-mBJ potential

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tensile strain increases bandgap and enhances thermoelectric figure of merit through modified electronic structure
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; +8% strain maximized ZT (0.78–0.79 at 800 K) with increased electrical conductivity

title: Theoretical design of optical fibers with protection of linear operation mode against external thermal and electric disturbances

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cloaking theory with engineered refractive index profile renders fiber insensitive to external thermal and electric fields

task: Starting mechanism for linear range extender using mechanical resonance
key_results: Resonance method enables rapid engine compression starting by increasing piston amplitude and frequency; compression ratio and peak gas pressure increase with excitation force; starting time reduced significantly

title: Computational intelligence-based investigation of heat transfer enhancement and entropy optimization in tri-hybrid nanofluid flow over a paraboloid needle
task: Heat transfer enhancement and entropy optimization in tri-hybrid nanofluid over heated needle
key_results: ANN-based Bvp4c hybrid approach successfully modeled TiO₂-MWCNT-Al₂O₃/ethylene glycol-water ternary nanofluid; ternary fluid enhanced wall shear stress and skin friction; higher magnetic/Casson parameters reduced heat transfer
comments: ANN integration addresses complex nonlinear rheology; ternary nanofluid shows marginal advantage in friction but slight decrease in Nusselt number trade-off.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ternary nanofluid provides superior thermal performance compared to binary hybrid nanofluid

title: Determination of optimal sampling wavelengths for reflectance measurement using sparse principal component analysis
task: Optimal wavelength selection for reflectance spectroscopy with limited channels
key_results: SPCA-selected wavelengths outperformed uniform sampling across 7–16 channels; lower RMSE, ΔE, and higher GFC values; validated on 1269 Munsell color chips
comments: Data-driven approach is superior to uniform spacing for constrained spectral measurement; practical for color science and material characterization applications.

model_io.model: Sparse Principal Component Analysis (SPCA) with Gaussian filter simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: SPCA-determined wavelengths better capture intrinsic spectral features than uniform sampling under channel constraints
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SPCA consistently achieved lower reconstruction error across all tested channel counts
